title.zh: Lloyds and Visa Settle $750,000 in USDC in Cross-Border Pilot
title.en: Lloyds and Visa Settle $750,000 in USDC in Cross-Border Pilot

current_state.zh: Lloyds and Visa completed a seven-day cross-border pilot settling $750,000 in USDC from Jersey to the US in under an hour, including over a weekend, with Lloyds using Canton and Visa a separate blockchain.
current_state.en: Lloyds and Visa completed a seven-day cross-border pilot settling $750,000 in USDC from Jersey to the US in under an hour, including over a weekend, with Lloyds using Canton and Visa a separate blockchain.
